evaluations.query: Review this JPEG for signs of localized editing or repeated copied regions. Give me a conservative report with observations, inference, confidence, and limitations.
expected_behavior: Runs forensic_photo_analyzer.py analyze on the uploaded image
Reads SUMMARY.md and forensic_report.json before answering
Discusses ELA, clone candidates, and at least one other evidence layer
Avoids claiming manipulation from a single indicator

evaluations.query: Compare these two photos of the same sculpture panel and identify any localized difference worth inspecting.
expected_behavior: Runs forensic_photo_analyzer.py compare on the two images
Reviews the difference map and comparison summary
Explains that lighting and viewpoint can cause false positives
Returns changed regions as leads rather than proof

evaluations.query: Use this archival PNG scan to look for hidden structure, periodicity, or unusual texture transitions in the inscription area.
expected_behavior: Runs forensic_photo_analyzer.py analyze on the PNG
Discusses the spectrum output and noise residual
Notes that ELA is less probative on non-JPEG originals

evaluations.query: Correct the perspective on this angled photo of the K4 panel, then run a steganography-focused analysis on the corrected image.
expected_behavior: Runs forensic_photo_analyzer.py correct first (auto or with manual corners)
Then runs forensic_photo_analyzer.py analyze on the corrected output
